# toolio

> A GitHub Copilot CLI plugin marketplace of reusable agents, skills, and engineering-workflow plugins, plus a vendored copy of the Agnostic Prompt Standard (APS) v1.0.

toolio is installed with `copilot plugin marketplace add jsburckhardt/toolio`, then
individual plugins with `copilot plugin install <plugin>@toolio`. Plugins bundle
Copilot agents (`*.agent.md` / `*.agent.yaml`), skills (`SKILL.md`), and slash
commands. Agents are authored to the APS v1.0 standard that lives in
`.github/skills/agnostic-prompt-standard/`.

## Repo docs

- [README](README.md): Marketplace overview, plugin table, and install commands.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Repository-wide instructions for AI agents and contributors.
- [Marketplace manifest](.github/plugin/marketplace.json): Source of truth for published plugins.
- [Pull request template](.github/pull_request_template.md): Contribution checklist.

## Plugins

- [soft-factory-agents manifest](plugins/soft-factory-agents/plugin.json): RPIV agents plus bootstrap, onboarding, issue generation, and the APS generator.
- [soft-factory-skills manifest](plugins/soft-factory-skills/plugin.json): RPIV, bootstrap, onboard-repo, issue-generator, excali, harness-cli-it, and APS skills plus shared templates.
- [soft-factory-extras manifest](plugins/soft-factory-extras/plugin.json): Extra agents and skills; references a bundled MCP config via `mcpServers`.
- [deep-research agent](plugins/soft-factory-extras/agents/deep-research.agent.md): Exa-powered, Microsoft-preferring deep-research orchestrator.
- [soft-factory-extras .mcp.json](plugins/soft-factory-extras/.mcp.json): Exa hosted MCP server (`https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp`).
- [visual-explainer manifest](plugins/visual-explainer/plugin.json): Self-contained HTML diagrams, reviews, recaps, and slide decks.
- [visual-explainer skill](plugins/visual-explainer/skills/visual-explainer/SKILL.md): The skill entrypoint with references and HTML templates.

## Standards

- [APS skill entrypoint](.github/skills/agnostic-prompt-standard/SKILL.md): Agnostic Prompt Standard v1.0 skill index.
- [APS structure](.github/skills/agnostic-prompt-standard/references/00-structure.md): Normative section structure for agents.
- [APS vocabulary](.github/skills/agnostic-prompt-standard/references/01-vocabulary.md): MUST/SHOULD/MAY vocabulary rules.
- [APS linting & formatting](.github/skills/agnostic-prompt-standard/references/02-linting-and-formatting.md): Lint and formatting rules.
- [APS error taxonomy](.github/skills/agnostic-prompt-standard/references/07-error-taxonomy.md): AG-xxx error codes.
- [Skill authoring guide](.github/skills/agnostic-prompt-standard/guides/skill-authoring-v1.0.0.guide.md): How to build a skill.
- [Repo APS agent](.github/agents/aps-v1.2.2.agent.md): Repo-level agent that generates APS-compliant agents.

## Optional

- [pr-review-complement skill](plugins/soft-factory-extras/skills/pr-review-complement/SKILL.md): PR-review complement skill in soft-factory-extras.
- [rpiv-research agent](plugins/soft-factory-agents/agents/rpiv-research.agent.md): RPIV research-stage agent.
- [rpiv-planner agent](plugins/soft-factory-agents/agents/rpiv-planner.agent.md): RPIV plan-stage agent.
- [rpiv-implementer agent](plugins/soft-factory-agents/agents/rpiv-implementer.agent.md): RPIV implement-stage agent.
- [rpiv-verifier agent](plugins/soft-factory-agents/agents/rpiv-verifier.agent.md): RPIV verify-stage agent.
- [Platform adapters](.github/skills/agnostic-prompt-standard/platforms/README.md): Per-platform adaptor.md files (copilot-cli, vscode-copilot, claude-code, opencode, generic).
- [session-metrics extension](session-metrics/extension.mjs): In-memory Copilot CLI session token/friction metrics.
